home.title: Spaces
home.noFavorites: Star a page (☆) to keep it here.

auth.pendingBody: You're signed in as {{email}}. You'll see the wiki once an admin grants you a role.
auth.signedOutBody: Open Clavis again through the Cloudflare Access login.
auth.rateLimitedBody: Please try again in a moment (up to a minute).

space.noHome: This space has no home page.
space.keyHelp: 2-10 characters starting with a capital letter (used in URLs and wiki links; cannot change later)
space.name: Name

page.missingBody: The {{key}} space has no page with this title. The link may be broken or the page renamed.
page.moveBody: Pick the new parent page. Child pages move along, and the page goes last in its new place.
page.deleteBody: This page and all its child pages move to the trash. You can restore them within 30 days.

editor.title: Title
editor.errorsBlock: Errors must be fixed before saving
editor.placeholder: Write Markdown. Type [[ to link a page.
editor.yamlBroken: The frontmatter YAML has an error. Fix it in the editor.
editor.draftOutdated: The page was saved again since then.
editor.renamedLinks: {{count}} page(s) still link to the old title (too many to rewrite at once, or archived); those links are broken.
editor.lintFailed: Not saved: fix the errors listed below.
editor.saveFailed: Could not save. Try again shortly.
editor.confirmLeave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway? (A draft stays in this browser.)
editor.conflictBody: Revision {{theirs}} was saved while you edited revision {{mine}}. Copy your text to the clipboard, load the latest version, and reapply your change.
editor.loadedLatestCopied: Loaded the latest version. Your text is on the clipboard.
editor.readOnly: You do not have permission to edit.
editor.linksUpdated: Updated links to the new title in {{count}} page(s).

lint.frontmatter-missing: The page must start with YAML frontmatter (---).
lint.frontmatter-yaml: The frontmatter YAML has a syntax error.
lint.frontmatter-field: Frontmatter "{{field}}" is missing or not an allowed value.
lint.attachment-exists: Attachment "{{filename}}" does not exist on this page.
lint.no-h1: Do not use H1 (#) in the body; the page title is the H1.
lint.heading-increment: Heading level jumps from H{{from}} to H{{to}}.
lint.code-lang: Code block has no language (e.g. ```ts), so it is not highlighted.
lint.doc-length: The page is {{kb}}KB; consider splitting it into child pages over {{limitKb}}KB.

search.palette: Type a page name or some text
search.shortQuery: Terms under 3 characters use plain substring matching (no index).

trash.help: Deleted pages are kept for {{days}} days, then removed for good. Child pages are restored together.
trash.renamed: Renamed to "{{title}}" because the title was taken.

admin.title: Admin
admin.tokenOnce: This token is shown only now. Store it in the agent's settings. If it is lost, issue a new one and revoke this one.
admin.renameHint: Past edits by this agent show the new name too.

health.title: Document health
health.help: Rule findings and broken links in this space. Rule results are recorded on save, and rechecked here when the rules change.

comments.title: Comments
comments.placeholder: Leave a comment or question (Markdown, ⌘Enter to post)

settings.title: {{name}} settings
settings.rulesHelp: The rules documents in this space are checked with, in the editor, on save and in the agent API alike.
settings.rulesReadOnly: This space's document rules. Only admins can change them.
settings.raisedWarning: Rules raised to error block saving documents that break them from now on. Saved documents stay as they are and must be fixed on their next save.
settings.sectionsHelp: Check to use a list for this space. One section per line; "결정 | Decision" accepts either name. An empty list means none.
settings.saved: Saved. Existing documents are rechecked with the new rules on the document health page.

templates.help: Your team's templates to pick from when creating a page. The seven built-in ones are always listed too.
templates.name: Name
templates.placeholders: {{title}} becomes the page title, {{owner}} its creator and {{date}} the creation date.
templates.confirmDelete: Delete the template "{{name}}"? Pages made from it stay.

history.title: History
history.start: Nothing older than r{{revision}} was kept (before history began).
history.noChanges: The text is the same (only the title or properties may differ).
history.textMissing: The text of this revision was not kept.
history.restoreBody: This revision's text is saved as a new revision. The current text stays in history, so you can go back again. The title does not change.
history.restoreConflict: Someone saved in the meantime. Refresh the list and try again.
history.restoreInvalid: This revision's text breaks a document rule that is now an error. Fix it in the editor instead.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.muteAgentEdits: Don't notify me of edits by agents

channels.help: Send this space's page and comment news to a Slack channel or another system (webhook). When an agent edits a page several times in a row, Slack hears about it once per 5 minutes.
channels.secretNote: Treat the URL like a password. Once saved, only part of it is shown.
